metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did sourthern African countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY), which covers 1981–present globally. Region is the union of Namibia, Botswana, and Lesotho from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017. Target window: 2018-12-01 to 2019-02-01. Baseline: 19 Dec–Jan pairs from Dec 2000–Jan 2019.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (precipitation dataset). Use all valid pixels within the region.
3. Logic for valid zero vs null: Compute pixel counts via Reducer.count(). If collections are empty -> C1. If counts are zero after processing -> C2. If any final metric is null/NaN -> C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017');
    const region = countries
      .filter(ee.Filter.inList('country_na', ['Namibia', 'Botswana', 'Lesotho']))
      .geometry();
    const targetStart = ee.Date('2018-12-01');
    const targetEnd = ee.Date('2019-02-01');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const chirpsDaily = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY');
    let targetCol = chirpsDaily.filterDate(targetStart, targetEnd).filterBounds(region);
    let targetCount = await targetCol.size().getInfo();

    // Fallback to monthly if daily somehow empty
    if (!targetCount || targetCount === 0) {
      const chirpsMonthly = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/Monthly');
      targetCol = chirpsMonthly.filterDate(targetStart, targetEnd).filterBounds(region);
      targetCount = await targetCol.size().getInfo();
      if (!targetCount || targetCount === 0) {
        console.log('Target images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // Target 2-month total precipitation
    const targetSum = targetCol.select('precipitation').sum().rename('precipitation');

    // 3. Baseline construction: Dec(Y)–Jan(Y+1) for Y=2000..2018 (19 pairs)
    const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2018);
    let baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(
      years.map(function (y) {
        y = ee.Number(y);
        const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 12, 1);
        const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(y.add(1), 2, 1);
        const sum = chirpsDaily
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .select('precipitation')
          .sum()
          .rename('precipitation')
          .set('pairYear', y);
        return sum;
      })
    );
    let baselinePairs = await baselineCol.size().getInfo();
    if (!baselinePairs || baselinePairs === 0) {
      // Fallback to monthly pairs if needed
      const chirpsMonthly = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/Monthly');
      baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(
        years.map(function (y) {
          y = ee.Number(y);
          const dec = chirpsMonthly
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y, y, 'year'))
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 12, 'month'))
            .first();
          const jan = chirpsMonthly
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y.add(1), y.add(1), 'year'))
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month'))
            .first();
          const sum = ee.Image(dec).add(ee.Image(jan)).rename('precipitation').set('pairYear', y);
          return sum;
        })
      );
      baselinePairs = await baselineCol.size().getInfo();
      if (!baselinePairs || baselinePairs === 0) {
        console.log(`Target images: ${targetCount}`);
        console.log('Baseline pairs: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // Baseline mean image (per-pixel mean of 19 pair sums)
    const baselineMeanImg = baselineCol.mean().rename('precipitation');

    // 4. Processing & Pixel Counts (detect C2)
    const reducerParams = { reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e12, bestEffort: true };
    const tgtCountPix = await targetSum.reduceRegion(reducerParams).get('precipitation').getInfo();
    const baseCountPix = await baselineMeanImg.reduceRegion(reducerParams).get('precipitation').getInfo();
    if (!tgtCountPix || tgtCountPix === 0 || !baseCountPix || baseCountPix === 0) {
      console.log(`Target images: ${targetCount}`);
      console.log(`Baseline pairs: ${baselinePairs}`);
      console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${tgtCountPix || 0}`);
      console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baseCountPix || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation: Regional means (mm over 2 months)
    const meanReducer = { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e12, bestEffort: true };
    const targetMean = await targetSum.reduceRegion(meanReducer).get('precipitation').getInfo();
    const baselineMean = await baselineMeanImg.reduceRegion(meanReducer).get('precipitation').getInfo();

    // 6. Validation & Final Answer
    if (targetMean === null || baselineMean === null || isNaN(targetMean) || isNaN(baselineMean)) {
      console.log('Calculation returned null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = targetMean - baselineMean;
    const pct = baselineMean !== 0 ? (targetMean / baselineMean) * 100.0 : null;

    // Evidence (concise)
    console.log(`Target days (Dec18–Jan19): ${targetCount}`);
    console.log(`Baseline pairs (Dec–Jan, 2000→2018/2019): ${baselinePairs}`);
    console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${tgtCountPix}`);
    console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baseCountPix}`);
    console.log(`Target 2-mo mean precip (mm): ${targetMean.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Baseline 2-mo mean precip (mm): ${baselineMean.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Diff (mm): ${diff.toFixed(1)} | % of baseline: ${pct !== null ? pct.toFixed(1) + '%' : 'NA'}`);

    // Decision: Less rain than long-term average?
    if (targetMean < baselineMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
